components.css: :host{--white:#ffffff;--stone:#f5f3ef;--line:#e4e0d8;--ink:#14202e;--slate:#5a6472;--navy:#0f2a44;--navy-deep:#0a1e31;--navy-line:rgba(244,241,234,.18);--on-navy:#f4f1ea;--on-navy-soft:rgba(244,241,234,.78);--gold:#b08d3c;--gold-soft:#d6bb7a;--gold-ink:#85661f;--error:#a3341b;--serif:'Bodoni Moda','Didot',Georgia,serif;--sans:'Archivo',system-ui,sans-serif;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);}.ds-cover{display:grid;justify-items:start;padding:3rem 2rem;background:var(--white);}.ds-cover>*{margin:0;animation:ds-rise 1s var(--ease) both;}.ds-cover h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(3rem,7vw,5rem);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:var(--navy);}.ds-cover h1>*{display:block;}.ds-cover h1 em{font-style:italic;padding-left:.55em;}.ds-cover__tenure{position:relative;margin-top:2rem !important;padding-left:4.5rem;font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,1.7vw,1.45rem);line-height:1.3;color:var(--ink);animation-delay:.12s !important;}.ds-cover__tenure::before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:.7em;width:3.25rem;height:1px;background:var(--gold);transform-origin:left;animation:ds-rule 1.1s .5s var(--ease) both;}.ds-cover__firm{margin-top:.75rem !important;padding-left:4.5rem;font-family:var(--sans);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--slate);animation-delay:.2s !important;}.ds-cover__firm span{margin-inline:.45em;color:var(--gold);}@keyframes ds-rule{from{transform:scaleX(0);}}@keyframes ds-rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-cover>*,.ds-cover__tenure::before{animation:none !important;}}

narrative.overview:
The homepage reads like an issue of a property magazine published under The Ridge Realty Group's masthead. It opens on a split cover: Marci's name stacked large in navy on white, with the valley photograph bleeding off the right edge. After that it runs as a sequence of spreads: an oversized headline over a hairline, a portrait on an offset plate beside a large serif lede, a staggered photo spread with captions, a centered pull quote, ruled service rows on navy, and a giant serif phone number to close. The grounds stay white and warm stone, the brand stays navy and gold, and the polish stays at luxury-brokerage level.

The editorial voice comes from type and composition, not ornament. Bodoni Moda carries every name, heading, lede and caption at weight 400. Its italic is held back for the words that carry meaning, and section headings stay upright. Square corners, 1px hairlines, underline fields, drop-cap prose and asymmetric 12-column placement replace cards, boxes and badges. Gold stays a hairline on light grounds. A deeper gold ink exists only for large italic display words.

The user picked this direction on 2026-11-06 over the earlier category-standard brokerage page, which felt "a bit more common and simple". The standing preference still applies: clean and elegant, no themed or costume worlds, no heavy dark page grounds.
keyCharacteristics: A split cover: a stacked serif name on white (6fr) beside a photograph that bleeds to the right edge (7fr), with an italic caption underneath.
Spreads on a 12-column grid, with offset placement, staggered photos and generous white space.
Bodoni Moda at 400 for display, ledes, captions and the phone number, with italic as an accent. Archivo at normal width for text and labels.
Section headings upright. Italic marks the emphasized word, the serif sub-line and the caption.
Gold as 1px rules and underlines. Gold Ink for large italic display words on white. Soft Gold for italic accents on navy.
Square corners, no cards, no eyebrows, no section numbers.
One authored entrance: the cover photo unveils, the gold rule draws in, and the text rises.

rules.name: The Hairline Gold Rule
rules.body: Ridge Gold is for 1px rules, underlines and small marks only. It is never set as text on white and never used as a fill. When gold has to be read as letters on a light ground, use Gold Ink, and only at display size in italic.

rules.name: The Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: The brand hues are the navy and gold from The Ridge Realty Group's logo. Do not add a third brand hue. The only extra color is the small functional green chip for the "open now" office status.

rules.name: The Light Ground Rule
rules.body: The page is white and stone. Navy fills bounded bands (services, footer) and buttons. It is never the overall page ground.

rules.name: The Meaningful Italic Rule
rules.body: Italic marks meaning, never decoration on every heading. It sets the emphasized word in a display line ("Metzger", "sold.", "28.5 million", "community."), the second line of a service title, and the serif secondary voice (sub-heads, tenure, captions, pitch titles). Routine section headings (Find Your Dream Home, Photo Gallery, Our Services, Call or Visit, Send Message) stay upright. One italic accent per display line at most.

rules.name: The Didone Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda sets names, headings, ledes, quotes, captions, the location field and the giant phone number, always at weight 400. It never sets labels or buttons. Archivo stays at normal width; do not use its width axis.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: No eyebrow, kicker label or section number sits above a heading. Spaced capitals belong to buttons, nav, form labels, fact terms, the cover firm line (below the name) and gallery place names (below the photo).

rules.name: The Asymmetric Spread Rule
rules.body: Compose on the 12-column grid with offsets and unequal spans, not centered stacks or equal card grids. Symmetry is kept for the pull quote alone.

rules.name: The One Bleed Rule
rules.body: The cover photograph is the only image that bleeds to the viewport edge. Gallery sources are only 1024px wide, so every other image stays inside the container and is never shown above about 1024px.

rules.name: The No Metric Row Rule
rules.body: Proof is stated in sentences (the lede), never as a row of stats or metric tiles.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A shadow appears only beneath a surface that floats over other content, and it is always soft and navy-tinted. No hard or offset shadows. The offset plate is a flat tint, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Nothing is rounded. Form comes from 1px lines and white space.

rules.name: The No Card Rule
rules.body: Content groups are separated by rules and space, never boxed. The message panel's stone fill is the only container.

rules.name: The Focus Ground Rule
rules.body: The focus ring is a 2px solid navy outline at 3px offset on light grounds, and soft gold on navy bands.

rules.name: The Single Entrance Rule
rules.body: There is one authored motion, on the cover. The photo unveils with a clip-path wipe from the right edge (1.5s). The gold tenure rule draws in from the left (scaleX, 1.1s after a 0.5s delay). The name, tenure, firm line and actions rise 14px and fade in, staggered 0, 0.12, 0.2 and 0.3s over 1s. Everything else is state feedback: hovers, the nav underline, the arrow nudge, the tile zoom, the menu panel and the lightbox fade. All motion uses cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1). Under prefers-reduced-motion, all animation and transitions are removed and scrolling is instant.

dos: Do keep grounds white and warm stone, with navy only on bounded bands and buttons.
Do use Ridge Gold only as 1px rules, underlines and small marks, Gold Ink only for large italic display words on white, and Soft Gold for accents on navy.
Do keep section headings upright and spend italic on the one word or line that carries meaning, plus the serif sub-lines and captions.
Do compose spreads on the 12-column grid with offsets, unequal spans and hairlines between parts.
Do set names, headings, ledes and captions in Bodoni Moda at 400, and everything else in Archivo at normal width.
Do keep every corner square and every line 1px.
Do use underline-only fields with labels above, turning navy on focus and Brick on error, with the rest-state underline at 3:1 or better against its ground.
Do use a navy focus ring on light grounds and soft gold on navy.
Do state proof in sentences, using the reference figures as given.
donts: Don't set Ridge Gold text on white, set Gold Ink below display size, or use gold as a fill.
Don't italicize every heading, or put more than one italic accent in a display line.
Don't put eyebrow labels, kickers or section numbers above headings.
Don't box content into cards, or build stats or metric rows.
Don't bleed any photo to the viewport edge except the cover, and don't show gallery sources above about 1024px.
Don't add rounded corners, boxed form fields (except the composed-message textarea), hard or offset shadows, or framed photos.
Don't add a second authored animation or scroll-triggered reveals, and don't leave anything moving under reduced motion.
Don't reintroduce themed or costume materials or dark full-page grounds.
